purpose: Proposed matched text-only evaluation of the pinned upstream BALROG naive agent on 255 fixed cases across all six environments. No real-model parity has run; this document is not permission to spend.

scope.selection: Every configured task type at predetermined seeds; identical cases on both sides; never filter by oracle or model success.
scope.sanity: Ten predetermined seed-0 cases span all six environments and several interaction families. Selection is based on coverage, not observed success. Sanity executions are excluded from formal statistics.
scope.manifest_policy: Hashes below bind the current original 255-case scope. Any approved source, scorer, native-budget or scope change requires new manifests, validation and a revised approved experiment; do not silently exclude the six unresolved NLE/MiniHack cases or promote private Crafter references.
scope.sanity_previous_split: Without --selection-plan or --task-ids-file, --split sanity retains all 58 seed-0 task families. Both launchers now support --selection-plan to select the exact proposed ten cases; prepare_parity.py generates the six per-environment datasets and validates both Docker and Daytona Harbor previews without credentials.

primary_experiment.harbor_agent: balrog-native bridge reusing the same pinned upstream naive implementation
primary_experiment.selection_reason: Dated model used in the pinned upstream README example; fits the native max_tokens/temperature Chat Completions client without changing agent behavior.
primary_experiment.provider_availability: Unconfirmed. This previously selected dated model is a proposal; no alias/model substitution without revising and confirming the plan.
primary_experiment.model_sampling_seed: Not supplied by upstream client; environment seeds fixed separately.
primary_experiment.timeout_caveat: The upstream client timeout=60 is not forwarded to the SDK. Live launchers now require an explicit positive per-environment execution timeout. The proposed 1,800 seconds is only a bounded diagnostic limit, not an agreed formal deadline. Both sides use the same execution deadline T; Harbor's outer agent deadline is T+120 seconds for artifact collection. Pin identical SDK and effective request behavior on both sides.
equivalence: Same prompts, observations, action parsing, invalid-action handling and native scoring
Same model settings, source snapshots, runtime dependencies and limits
Fresh agent history and environment for every episode
Preserve raw trajectories, request metadata, usage, returned model IDs and configuration hashes; redact secrets
primary_experiment.outer_timeout_policy: Measure per-environment latency, actual calls and retries during the approved diagnostic sanity stage, then agree and freeze sufficiently provisioned formal deadlines on both sides before the first full pair. Early native termination is valid; outer timeout or cost-cap interruption is an incomplete infrastructure outcome, never score zero or native completion. Do not silently shorten native action limits. If the unchanged scope is infeasible, obtain agreement for a separately versioned symmetric scope/budget revision and rerun its validation before paid formal execution.
primary_experiment.harbor_revision_policy: 0.27.0 is the host-harness candidate pinned by parity/requirements-harbor.lock for current offline preparation; the completed historical 255-task reference run used 0.26.0. Agree the final harness pin before paid runs and repeat preflight after any version change. Local preparation does not establish Daytona runtime compatibility.
primary_experiment.adapter_revision_policy: Freeze the reviewed PR commit plus generated task, runner and image digests before each experiment revision; the current proposal does not certify an uncommitted checkout as a final execution pin.

implementation_status.real_model_validation: Not run; offline fake-client and reference validation are separate evidence.

offline_preparation.selection: Implemented: exact ten tasks across six unchanged manifests; duplicate, unknown, wrong-environment and drifted-plan rejection.
offline_preparation.host_configuration: Implemented and locally tested: hash-locked Harbor[daytona] 0.27.0, explicit ten-task selection, Docker/Daytona launch paths for both sides, top-level Harbor concurrency, retry=0, correct CLI entry and explicit live deadlines. Remote execution is untested.

See docs/parity_preparation.md for the separate validation scopes.

primary_experiment.nle_native_no_progress_timeout_meaning: 150 native calls without a game-clock advance; not 150 elapsed game turns and not a reward-progress timeout.

nle_timeout_feasibility.interpretation: Using all 100,000 allowed model-action cycles within 1,800 seconds would require an average of at most 18 ms per cycle, including provider latency, simulation and recording. This is arithmetic, not a latency forecast or a claim that every NLE episode reaches its action limit. The diagnostic deadline is not evidence of formal completion feasibility.

execution.formal_platform_proposed: Daytona on both sides, as requested by the team, after validating identical pinned assets, game-sidecar isolation, collection and separate verification.
execution.current_platform: Completed game evidence uses local Linux Docker/Compose. Both original-side and Harbor-side launchers now support Docker/Daytona configuration. The original side runs the same native evaluator in a derived single-game image; Harbor uses its game sidecar and separate verifier. Daytona SDK/schema/source/fake-provider checks are local preparation only; no remote sandbox or model experiment has run.
execution.preflight: Verify all 255 original references and representative wrong-action controls on the selected platform; preserve partial scores and secure artifact transfer. The existing 239 full-score plus 16 diagnostic baseline does not by itself satisfy the guide's 100% oracle gate.
execution.fallback: If the required sidecar/collect/separate-verifier topology cannot be supported on Daytona, document the blocker and obtain maintainer approval for an alternative. Local Docker evidence is not Daytona validation; do not mix platforms within a comparison.

stages.name: paired_sanity
stages.approval_gate: Approve the exact ten-task selection, finite sanity cost/token limits and the proposed 1,800-second diagnostic deadline first. Timed-out episodes remain incomplete; resolve timing or platform issues before scaling.

stages.name: first_full_pair
stages.approval_gate: Both sanity sides are reviewed, unresolved timeouts/errors are diagnosed, and settings plus per-environment formal deadlines are frozen; approve first full-pair cost/token/runtime limits before launch.

stages.name: two_additional_full_pairs
stages.approval_gate: One complete full run on each side reviewed before scaling. Execute paired repeats 2 and 3; never finish three on one side first.

stopping_rules: Validate requests, usage, resets and scoring on both sides before scaling beyond sanity
Pause on API/quota/simulator/verifier/transport errors; retain them as infrastructure failures, not score zero

Inspect all-zero or otherwise non-discriminating results separately for every environment and the aggregate after sanity and the first full pair. An environment with all-zero outcomes on both sides is weak parity evidence even if other environments score well; report it and agree any stronger-model diagnostic before changing the frozen formal experiment.
Do not select tasks or add runs until overlap appears; obtain agreement for changes and preserve all attempts
After evaluation fixes, freeze corrected inputs and restart the affected paired comparison; never pool incompatible runs
execution.retry_policy: Preserve every API retry, failed attempt and original artifact. Genuine agent failures remain native scores. Infrastructure failures invalidate completion, never become synthetic zeros; replacements require a recorded cause and an agreed retry allowance, not selection of the better outcome.

supplementary_standard_agent.provider_availability: Unconfirmed. Verify the exact model plus Anthropic Messages, streaming and tool-use behavior required by this pinned Claude Code release; OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions support alone is insufficient. No alias or model substitution without a revised confirmed configuration.
supplementary_standard_agent.selection_reason: A concrete standard CLI-agent proposal with a fixed released CLI version and a dated model snapshot. Official sources were checked on 2026-11-21; this does not establish availability through 2077ai or compatibility with this adapter.
supplementary_standard_agent.interface: Existing public balrog observe and balrog act commands and generated task instructions; no private oracle snapshots or game filesystem access. Confirm whether this interface suffices or a separate compatibility dataset is required.
supplementary_standard_agent.implementation_boundary: Harbor supplies the standard agent, but this specific pinned agent/model/gateway configuration has not been configured or tested. This proposal is not a runnable launch configuration.
supplementary_standard_agent.platform: Approved Daytona topology; validate game sidecar, protected result collection and separate verifier before paid execution.

evaluation.selection: Every original task family at seed 0, selected before outcomes; a 58-case subset of the unchanged 255-case manifests. No filtering by oracle or model success.

supplementary_standard_agent.action_budget_caveat: Native action allowance is not a model-call ceiling for a CLI agent, which can issue multiple game actions through one tool invocation. Usage, tool calls, retries and token costs require separate accounting.
supplementary_standard_agent.execution_order: Approve and run the ten-task smoke first, then one complete 58-case run, review it, and approve the remaining two runs. Preserve every failed or interrupted attempt; no automatic job retry.
supplementary_standard_agent.configuration_gate: Before any paid CLI request, approve and freeze the exact installation source/version, endpoint/protocol, model ID, effective system prompt/tools/decoding/reasoning/token settings, CLI config, environment variables, per-environment deadlines and finite stage limits. Do not inherit the primary naive-agent settings JSON as if it were a Claude Code configuration.
supplementary_standard_agent.reporting: Report native progression per environment and the equal-weight mean of six environment means across three complete subset runs, with raw run arrays and sample SEM. Label the 58-case seed-0 scope explicitly; inspect per-environment all-zero results. These Harbor-only generalization results are not matched original-versus-Harbor parity and do not establish full-255 performance.
supplementary_standard_agent.primary_comparison: Supplementary evidence required by Scenario 3; it does not replace matched naive-agent parity. Its 184 episodes and separate costs are outside the 1,550 primary episodes.

statistics.full_run_score: Compute each environment mean over its complete frozen scope, then take the equally weighted mean of six environment means. Do not use the flat 255-episode mean.
statistics.report: Mean +/- sample SEM across three full repeats, separately for original and Harbor, for each environment and the equal-weight six-environment score.
statistics.diagnostics: Keep run arrays, per-type and per-episode results, actions, usage and failure classification. Range overlap is the repository criterion, not proof of statistical equivalence.
statistics.limitation: Repeated runs estimate model variability on the fixed selected seeds, not population uncertainty across all possible worlds.
statistics.excluded: Sanity executions and scripted mock-API artifacts never enter formal run arrays.
statistics.after_first_pair: Report the two single-run scores and per-case diagnostics without SEM; sample SEM is undefined with one run per side.
statistics.range_overlap_scope: Check and publish raw run-score ranges for each environment and the equal-weight aggregate; aggregate overlap must not hide a systematic environment-level mismatch.
statistics.non_discriminating_results: Evaluate floor/all-zero outcomes per environment, not only on the six-environment aggregate. Range overlap for an all-zero environment does not by itself demonstrate a useful matched measurement.

resources.ceiling_note: Sum of unchanged native action budgets across proposed executions, assuming the naive agent's one completion per action. This is not expected usage, a provider-request ceiling including retries, or spending authorization. NLE dominates; retain its original budget unless a revised experiment is approved.
resources.stage_limits: Pending maintainer approval, separately for primary sanity, first full pair, two additional pairs, supplementary CLI smoke, first subset run and remaining repeats. Formal per-environment deadlines are unset until diagnostic latency/usage is reviewed. Initial concurrency is 1; no automatic job retry.
resources.budget: No price or dollar forecast is assumed. Confirm current provider billing and quota, measure sanity usage including retries, then estimate and approve each later stage. Stop before the approved cap; an interrupted run is not a complete formal result.
resources.credentials: Request 2077ai inference and Daytona access through an agreed private secret channel. Store credentials in ignored environment files or a secret store, never in this proposal, PR comments, logs or artifacts.
resources.combined_episode_count_note: 1,550 primary matched-comparison episodes plus 184 supplementary Harbor-only CLI episodes. This is a conditional scope total, not approval, an expected spend or a promise of completion.

Raw native and Harbor trajectories/settings/usage/provenance uploaded to the agreed parity dataset
Reproducible original-benchmark fork and task-dataset publication as required

preferred_benchmark_treatment.status: PROPOSED_NOT_APPROVED; original 255 case IDs, hashes, native budgets and scorer remain unchanged

nle.preferred: Preserve the pinned native fractional scorer for the first adapter-parity target and explicitly request acceptance of the partial reference/scorer limitation. Keep scorer correctness and the separate lack of a five-seed ascension policy distinct.
nle.score_limit: Pinned reachable-key ceiling 0.8067964442444019; no normalization, synthetic win or applied scorer patch.
nle.alternative: If a correction is required, propose and pin an explicit upstream ascension-event fix identically on both sides, revalidate and issue a new experiment revision. A scorer fix alone does not supply successful ascension oracles.

minihack.preferred: Preserve the original 100-action benchmark target and request an explicit documented exception for Hard Boxoban seed 0. Independent push-level A* and exact player-step BFS establish a 104-move minimum for the documented instance/model; native validation confirms truncation at 100. This is an upstream action-budget limitation, not evidence that the adapter lowered the budget.
minihack.upstream_proposal_status: Open unmerged Draft as reviewed on 2026-11-21; no acceptance claimed.
minihack.alternative: If full task solvability is required, prefer the separately proposed symmetric 200-action revision for all ten Boxoban cases, preserving 100 for other MiniHack cases, rather than changing or dropping only the failing seed. Pin the approved upstream/fork revision on both sides, regenerate hashes and action-budget totals, validate, and create a new experiment revision before formal runs. The existing original 255-case target is not claimed to be fully solvable.

crafter.preferred: Request acceptance of V45 as oracle-only privileged reference evidence and, separately, of the protected authoritative-native-state fallback for upstream object-order replay divergence. Normal model agents continue using public text/actions only.
crafter.evidence: 40/40 native games achieved 22/22 within 2,000 actions; 10/10 separate-verifier Harbor trials and 10/10 saved-artifact-only regrades scored 1. All ten Harbor trials used the fallback with replay_verified=false; regrading is not fresh gameplay.
crafter.promotion_gate: Maintainer acceptance, production integration, published reproducible oracle/controller and evidence, and appropriate validation are required before promoting canonical references. No promotion, deterministic replay, ordinary-agent result or model parity is claimed here.

preferred_benchmark_treatment.revision_rule: Any accepted scorer, native-budget or scope change requires explicit new source/fork pins and experiment identity, matching changes on both sides, refreshed manifest/runtime hashes and budget arithmetic, and validation before launch. Never pool results across revisions or silently rewrite the archived baseline.
